name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX4
author: Reboxed
description: 2-deck controller, from the manufacturer's MIDI mapping: 8 pad modes, CALL < > that halve / double a playing loop (like the DDJ-GRV6), SHIFT + CALL for MEMORY / DELETE, SHIFT + jog search. Every mapped control is handled; not yet tried on the hardware: report problems with the MIDI monitor (Preferences > MIDI).
